arabic text: DUNYA WALO SHABIR KAY MATAM PE PABANDI KYUN\nLAGATY HO
english translation text: People of the world, why do you try\nto forbid the mourning of Shabbir?

arabic text:
ZAHRA K PAK GHARANY KO, MAQTAL ME JINHO NE MAR
DIYA,
TUM UN K HI KUCH LAGTY HO, SUCH BAT KO YAD
KARATY HO.
english translation text:
Those who killed Zahra’s pure
family upon the battlefield— you
seem to belong to them, for you
object when the truth is remembered.

arabic text:
ZAINAB NE BARY DUKH JHELY HEN DARBARON ME
BAZARON ME,
SANG BARSATY THY SUB SHAMI IN BE CHADAR
MASTOORON PE,
MOLA K JULOOSON ME PHIR TUM YE RASEM WOHI
DOHRATY HO
english translation text:
Zainab endured immense suffering
in courts and marketplaces. The
people of Shaam hurled stones at
those unveiled, protected ladies.
Now, during the processions of the
Maula, you repeat that same cruelty.

arabic text:
JO LOG ALI K DUSHMAN THY, DIYA HASSAN KO SUM UN
LOGON NY,
SHABIR PE KHANJAR CHALA KR PHIR, OLAD E ALI KO
QAID KIYA,
TUM PAIROKAR UNHI K HO, KHUD APNA ROOP DIKHATY
HO
english translation text:
Those who were enemies of Ali
poisoned Hasan. They drew
the dagger across Shabbir and
imprisoned Ali’s descendants.
You follow in their footsteps
and reveal your true nature.

arabic text:
ABBAS CHALY JAB PANI KO, ZAINAB SAR PEET K RONY
LAGI,
MERE SAR PE JO MAA KI CHADAR HE, JB SHAAMI AAKR
LOOTEN GY,
HUM ZINDA RAHEN K MAR JAYEN, HUME TUM JO CHOR
K JATY HO
english translation text:
When Abbas went to bring
water, Zainab beat her head
and cried: ‘When the people of
Shaam come to seize the veil my
mother gave me, will we live or
die, that you leave us and go?’

arabic text:
ABBAS KO PAHLY QATL KIYA,PHIR AAG LAGAI KHAIMO
KO,
GHAZI K ALAM JALA KR TUM YE SABIT KRNA CHAHTY
HO,
MAQTAL ME SITAM JO REH GYE THY WO AB TUM AAKR
DHAATY HO
english translation text:
First they killed Abbas, then
set the tents on fire. By
burning Ghazi’s standards, you
seek to prove that the
cruelties left unfinished in
Karbala are now being renewed by you.

arabic text:
ZINDAN ME SAKINA AUR ZAINAB YE DEKH K PHIR ROTI
HOTI HONGI,
SHABBIR K MATAMDARON PE ANDHERY ZULM KAMANY
LAGY,
ABI NASAL YAZEED KI BAQI HE, TUM KHUD HI YE
BATLATY HO
english translation text:
In the prison, Sakina and
Zainab must weep again to
see dark oppression
inflicted upon Shabbir’s
mourners. You yourselves show
that Yazid’s lineage still survives.

arabic text:
AKHTAR HAR MATMI KO JANAT MAHSHAR ME
DILAYENGI ZAHRA,
SHABIR K DARD ME GUM HO KR JO SEENA KOBI KARTY
HO,
WALLAH TUM APNY HATHON SE FIRDOS ME GHAR
BANWATY HO
english translation text:
Akhtar, Zahra will grant every
mourner Paradise on the Day of
Judgement. When, lost in
Shabbir’s grief, you strike your
chest, by God, you build your own
home in Paradise with your hands.
